'''Yuli B. Rudyak''' (24 April 1948 - 24 August 2024) was a professor of [[mathematics]] at the [[University of Florida]] in Gainesville, Florida.  He obtained his doctorate from [[Moscow State University]] under the supervision of [[M. M. Postnikov]].  His main research interests are
[[geometry]], [[topology]] and [[symplectic topology]].

==Books==
*{{citation|title=On Thom spectra, orientability, and cobordism. With a foreword by [[Haynes Miller]]|first=Yu.|last=Rudyak|series= Springer Monographs in Mathematics|publisher=Springer-Verlag|location=Berlin|year=1998}}
:Reviewer [[Donald M. Davis (mathematician)]] for [[MathSciNet]] wrote: "This book provides an excellent and thorough treatment of various topics related to cobordism. It should become an indispensable tool for advanced graduate students and workers in algebraic topology."<ref>{{mr|1627486}}</ref>
:The book listed 118 cites at [[Google Scholar]] in 2011.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120714085443/http://scholar.google.com/scholar?cites=4127595561151112303&as_sdt=5,31&sciodt=0,31&hl=en|title=Google Scholar search results}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Rudyak is the father of Marina Rudyak, who is an Assistant Professor of Chinese Studies at the University of Heidelberg.
